LanguageData.LC_FairyFestival_CareMsg: Fairy Festival's warm care lingers around {0}.
LanguageData.LC_FairyFestival_DevouredLetterText: {0} carried Fairy's Care while approaching {1}—breaking the fairies' jealous oath. In a flash of iridescent wings, {0} was torn apart and devoured.
LanguageData.LC_WellCheers_RedCanMsg: {0} drank a Cherry Red WellCheers soda, mending surface wounds.
LanguageData.LC_WellCheers_BlueCanMsg: {0} drank a Deep Sea Blue WellCheers soda, soothing mental strain.
LanguageData.LC_WellCheers_PurpleCanMsg: {0} drank a Twilight Purple WellCheers soda, uplifting body and mind.
LanguageData.LC_WellCheers_BadDrinkMsg: The tainted can drugged {0} into freezing hypothermic slumber as surging waves and a fishing boat swept across the chamber!
LanguageData.LC_WellCheers_DrinkGizmoDesc: Choose a colonist to directly grab and drink a free {0} soda from WellCheers (independent cooldown; beware bad cans).
LanguageData.LC_PunishingBird_EscapedText: {0} slipped out of containment! Hold your fire—do not attack it unless you wish to awaken its crimson maw.
LanguageData.LC_PunishingBird_KilledText: {0} has dissolved back into an abnormality egg.
LanguageData.LC_PunishingBird_EnragedMsg: Punishing Bird was provoked! Its chest splits wide in towering fury!
LanguageData.LC_PunishingBird_PunishMsg: Punishing Bird's crimson maw snapped shut upon {0} before vanishing into dormancy.
LanguageData.LC_PunishingBird_ReturnMsg: Punishing Bird grew tired of pecking and returned quietly into its egg.
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_EscapedText: {0} floated out of containment launching hypnotic dream orbs! If left unharmed for 60s it will quietly return to its egg, but attacking it triggers its grotesque rooster transformation. Wake anyone put to sleep within 60 seconds.
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_TransformMsg: Void Dream was attacked! Amid a burst of billowing wool clouds, it morphed into a towering multi-eyed rooster!
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_ReturnMsg: Void Dream drifted peacefully for a while before dissolving gently back into its egg.
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_LowTemperanceMsg: {0}'s low Temperance disturbed Void Dream, lowering its Qliphoth Counter!
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_SleepMsg: Void Dream's hypnosis lulled {0} into a deep coma atop a floating dream cloud!
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_SecondCrowMsg: A second crow tore through {0}'s slumbering nightmare!
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_NightmareMsg: No one woke {0} in time—Void Dream's nightmare erupted inside their skull!
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_WakeGizmoDesc: Order a colonist to shake {0} awake before nightmare shock triggers.
LanguageData.LC_VoidDream_WokeMsg: {1} shook {0} awake from the void nightmare.
LanguageData.LC_HeartOfAspiration_EquipGizmoDesc: Choose a colonist to equip The Heart of Aspiration for combat buffs. They must shed enemy blood within 60 seconds and before returning it.
LanguageData.LC_HeartOfAspiration_ReturnGizmoDesc: Order {0} to return The Heart of Aspiration to its pedestal.
LanguageData.LC_HeartOfAspiration_EquipMsg: {0} borrowed The Heart of Aspiration. Shed enemy blood within 60 seconds!
LanguageData.LC_HeartOfAspiration_RestlessMsg: The Heart of Aspiration pounds furiously in {0}'s chest—draw enemy blood soon!
LanguageData.LC_HeartOfAspiration_BerserkMsg: {0} failed to satiate The Heart of Aspiration in time and snapped into a berserk rage!
LanguageData.LC_HeartOfAspiration_PrematureReturnMsg: {0} returned The Heart of Aspiration without shedding blood—its frustrated pulse drove them berserk!
LanguageData.LC_HeartOfAspiration_SafeReturnMsg: {0} satisfied The Heart of Aspiration in battle and safely returned it.
LanguageData.LC_HeartOfAspiration_MentalReason: The Heart of Aspiration's unquenched frenzy
